# Mattermost Agents plugin

> Mattermost Agents (plugin ID `mattermost-ai`) adds self-hosted AI agents to Mattermost. Agents act on a user's behalf through built-in Mattermost tools, remote MCP servers, and plugin tools, using the LLM of your choice including local models. The plugin also includes the official built-in Mattermost MCP server, so external AI clients such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code can connect to Mattermost.

Does Mattermost have an official MCP server? Yes. It is built into this plugin and needs no separate installation or binary. After an admin sets **Enable Mattermost MCP Server (HTTP)** in **System Console > Plugins > Agents > Model Context Protocol (MCP)**, MCP clients connect over streamable HTTP (not SSE) to `https://<your-mattermost-server>/plugins/mattermost-ai/mcp-server/mcp`. Authentication is OAuth 2.0 with dynamic client registration, or a Mattermost personal access token. Every call runs with the signed-in user's own Mattermost permissions. It exposes more than 100 tools for posts, channels, teams, users, files, search, scheduled posts, and more. Enabling the HTTP endpoint requires a Mattermost Enterprise license or higher, and tools that change state need Enterprise or higher.

Notes for readers:

- Requires Mattermost Server v12.0.0 or later, and a configured Site URL.
- Most Go packages are at the repository root. `mcpserver/` holds the MCP server and tools, `llm/` and `bifrost/` the LLM providers, `mcp/` the MCP client, `conversations/` turn handling, and `webapp/` the React UI.
- The standalone `mattermost-mcp-server` binary in `mcpserver/` is for development and local use only. Production deployments use the embedded server in the plugin.
- Docs in `docs/` are also published at https://docs.mattermost.com/agents/docs/<name>, for example https://docs.mattermost.com/agents/docs/mcp_server. The admin guide is published at https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/configure/agents-admin-guide and the user guide at https://docs.mattermost.com/end-user-guide/agents.
- Features depend on the Mattermost license level. The license table is in the admin guide.

## Mattermost MCP server

- [Mattermost MCP Server](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/mcp_server.md): What the official built-in MCP server is, how to enable it, the endpoint URL, OAuth and personal access token authentication, setup for Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, and VS Code, license requirements, and troubleshooting
- [Admin Guide: Mattermost MCP Server](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/admin_guide.md#mattermost-mcp-server): Admin configuration and the full list of built-in tools
- [MCP server package README](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/mcpserver/README.md): The standalone development server and tool reference for contributors

## Using agents

- [Use Mattermost Agents as your personal AI assistant](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/personal_agent.md): One conversation with an agent that acts on your behalf across channels, MCP servers, and integrations
- [User Guide](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/user_guide.md): Direct messages, the Agents pane, channel mentions, auto-reply, tools and approvals, files, summaries, AI search, and meeting summaries (published at https://docs.mattermost.com/end-user-guide/agents)
- [Custom Prompts](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/features/custom_prompts.md): Save, share, and pin reusable prompts
- [Channel Summaries](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/features/channel_summaries.md): Summarize channel activity or ask questions about a channel
- [Usage Tips](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/usage_tips.md): Prompting techniques and workflow tips

## Administration and governance

- [Admin Guide](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/admin_guide.md): Installation, services, agents, MCP servers, tool policies, access control, web and semantic search, audit logging, OpenTelemetry tracing, and the license table (published at https://docs.mattermost.com/administration-guide/configure/agents-admin-guide)
- [Managing Agents](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/features/managing_agents.md): Create, edit, version, export, and import agents, and control their access and MCP tools
- [Multiplayer Tool Calling](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/features/multiplayer_tool_calling.md): Tool approval, credentials, and result visibility when agents are used in shared channels
- [Upgrading to Agents V2](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/upgrading_to_2.0.md): Upgrade path and migrations from v1.x

## LLM providers and sovereign AI

- [LLM Provider Configuration](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/providers.md): Local models through OpenAI-compatible APIs, OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, Google Gemini and Vertex AI, Cohere, Mistral, and Scale AI
- [AWS Bedrock Setup](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/aws_bedrock_setup.md): Use Amazon Bedrock with IAM instance profiles
- [Implementing Sovereign AI](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/sovereign_ai.md): Run agents with local models and keep data under your control

## Development

- [README](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/README.md): Overview, installation, and development setup
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/AGENTS.md): Repository layout, commands, and conventions for contributors and coding agents
- [Bridge client](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/public/bridgeclient/README.md): Go client for other Mattermost plugins to call agents and LLM services

- [Load Testing](https://github.com/mattermost/mattermost-plugin-agents/blob/master/docs/load-testing.md): Mock LLM and load-test-ng controller for non-production load tests
